summary: With hands-on experience in full-stack development, I build scalable and efficient web and mobile applications. Proficient in modern frontend technologies including React.js, React Native, and Next.js, along with backend development using Node.js, I adapt quickly to evolving technology stacks and development environments. I work extensively with databases such as MySQL, SQL Server, and MongoDB to design reliable and data-driven applications. Passionate about creating high-quality user experiences and robust backend systems, I focus on delivering maintainable and performance-oriented solutions while continuously learning and improving as a developer.

skills.label: Development
skills.value: Javascript, Docker, Python, SQL, Kafka, PostgreSQL

experience.title: Full-Stack Developer
bullets: Developed scalable web and mobile applications using React.js, Next.js, and React Native to deliver responsive and user-friendly interfaces.
Built RESTful APIs and backend services using Node.js, ensuring secure and efficient data processing.
Designed and optimized database schemas using PostgreSQL, MySQL, and MongoDB for high-performance data management.
Implemented containerized applications using Docker to streamline development and deployment workflows.
Integrated Kafka-based messaging systems to support asynchronous communication and scalable data processing.
Improved application performance by optimizing SQL queries and database indexing across PostgreSQL and MSSQL.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality features and maintain scalable system architecture.

projects.name: Project: Web Application Platform
bullets: Built a full-stack web application using Next.js (frontend) and Node.js (backend).
Implemented secure authentication and API services with Node.js.
Designed and managed relational databases using PostgreSQL and MySQL.
Containerized the application using Docker for easier deployment and environment consistency.

projects.name: Project: Mobile Application
bullets: Developed a cross-platform mobile application using React Native.
Integrated backend APIs built with Node.js and connected to MongoDB for data storage.
Optimized performance and improved user experience with responsive UI components.

projects.name: Project: Real-time Data Processing System
bullets: Built a real-time data pipeline using Kafka for message streaming.
Processed and stored data in PostgreSQL and Redis for fast access and caching.
Implemented backend services in Node.js and Python to handle data processing tasks.

education.school: University of Management and Technology, Lahore.
